probe_scope.target_semantics: broker/front close-rejection response semantics for OnRspOrderInsert insufficient-position response offset after submitted CLOSETODAY

observed_claims: OnRspOrderInsert is the error response callback for ReqOrderInsert field-fill and CTP errors.
The callback receives pInputOrder, pRspInfo, nRequestID and bIsLast.
The documented pInputOrder field list includes CombOffsetFlag, InstrumentID, Direction, LimitPrice and VolumeTotalOriginal.
The documented pRspInfo fields include ErrorID and ErrorMsg.
external_sources.usefulness: confirms callback shape and source field boundary
external_sources.closure_gap: does not explain why a close-today submit can produce a response input-order offset value of generic close, or how the broker/front should semantically interpret that mismatch

observed_claims: The guide identifies Shanghai Futures Information Technology Co., Ltd. as document source.
SHFE position calculation distinguishes today and yesterday position quantities.
ReqOrderInsert uses CThostFtdcInputOrderField and assigns CombOffsetFlag for offset intent.
Trading core error responses are returned through OnRspOrderInsert, while order-state and trade-state callbacks have separate roles.
external_sources.usefulness: stronger source candidate for position model and callback path
external_sources.closure_gap: does not provide a broker/front rule proving the observed response offset value is a valid semantic closeout, nor an adapter-native repair beyond local diagnostics
